playwrightVisualHarness.evidenceBasis: Previous independent audit report; five PNG files were confirmed present in this session
playwrightVisualHarness.scope: Five visual scenarios run only in a synthetic React 17 harness with partially reused pure modules; they do not launch the packaged Electron application or certify a live Kubernetes API (accumulative validation reserved for R7-09)

point_1_resourceVersion_concurrency_cont.mechanism: Client-side comparison when an expected version is provided; metadata.resourceVersion is sent in the PATCH body for Kubernetes-side concurrency control. Tests verify the payload and a mocked 409 response only; no live API server was exercised.

point_2_wait_for_running_status.mechanism: waitForContainerRunning checks state.running before createPodTerminalTab; the test uses mocked Pod responses, not a live cluster

point_3_tail_all_and_log_concurrency.mechanism: tailLines: 0 (TAIL_ALL) omits tailLines; tailLines: undefined retains legacy default; requestId check on catch/finally

point_4_strict_quantity_parser.mechanism: STRICT_NUMBER_REGEX rejects 1..2, 2.3.4m, 1.2.3Gi, 12pods, 1.5 pods; yields status: N/A without distortion

point_5_multicluster_identity_protection.mechanism: Unknown identity rejection, active cluster check pre/post dispatch and during polling

point_6_monotonic_generation_isolation.mechanism: Monotonic generation token (currentGeneration) invalidated on dialog open, cancel/close, unmount, pod change, and dispatch; post-await re-validation silently discards stale responses without MobX mutation

point_7_cooperative_cancellation_get_can.mechanism: AbortSignal and isCancelled are checked before GET, after GET, and before PATCH dispatch; mocked tests verify no request.patch invocation when cancellation is observed before dispatch. AbortSignal is not passed to the HTTP PATCH request and cannot reverse a dispatched or accepted mutation.

point_8_prod_guard_double_operational_co.mechanism: PROD Guard requires two operational confirmations: checkbox confirmation and exact Pod name typing into prodConfirmationInput before enabling submit; canonical environment configs via getClusterEnvironmentConfig

point_9_hallazgo_a_nine_cooperative_prec.mechanism: Local cooperative checks cover generation, cancellation, cluster identity/health, target descriptors and fresh Pod identity/context. Mocked tests verify selected failures stop before request.patch; local checks do not close the race after the final check. resourceVersion is a separate Kubernetes-side concurrency mechanism and was not live-tested.

point_10_hallazgo_b_headroom_unknown_vs_.mechanism: Strict distinction in headroom calculator between explicit zero usage (usedRaw === '0' -> 0% consumption, status: 'normal') and unknown/missing usage (status or status.used absent or key missing -> status: 'N/A', percentage: undefined, usedFormatted: 'N/A')

point_11_hallazgo_c_reentrancy_execution.mechanism: Execution barrier (isExecuting observable lock) in AttachDebugContainerDialog rejecting rapid double-clicks, consecutive programmatic invocations, and pending PATCH invocations without invalidating generation or aborting in-flight operation
